visual_clone_mission.goal: Make the local contact page reproduce the reference contact page on desktop and mobile with no unresolved P0 or P1 deviations.
visual_clone_mission.global_objective: Clone X, where X is Kontakta oss, while keeping GESAB branding, Swedish content, real contact details, and shared application components.

hard_rules.rule: Use Browser, raw CDP measurements, and screenshots for visual verification.
Keep contact visual overrides scoped to the contact CSS module.
Verify mobile navigation, input focus, submit hover, FAQ, and map states.
Do not alter excluded page routes.
